title: Fortland

services.name: event rentals
services.desc: Stunning coastal beauty mixes with rare historic architecture; the tranquility of nature meets the life of the working waterfront; a spirit of adventure mingles with the comforts of home. Whether for dinner, cocktails, a lobster bake, or dancing, our 1500-sq-foot dock is a beautiful waterfront option for gathering with a view of Fort Gorges, Portland, and Falmouth Foreside. This 40’ diameter tent is a great place to get out of the hot sun or warm summer rain. This is where you go when you’re gathering to cook and eat a meal in our outdoor kitchen or simply want to pass your time playing cards and resting. On a clear day, you can see four famous Casco Bay lighthouses from this 500-sq-ft

blurb: Stunning coastal beauty mixes with rare historic architecture; the tranquility of nature meets the life of the working waterfront; a spirit of adventure mingles with the comforts of home. Set within historic Fort Scammel on House Island in Casco Bay, Fortland offers a getaway like no other.
